facts.fact: BoFiNet (Botswana Fibre Networks) announced on 2026-09-23 a long-term international capacity lease with an unnamed South African partner, raising its available international capacity through the Ramatlabama and Pioneer Gate border crossings (both into South Africa) from 300 Gbit/s to 1 Tbit/s; two crossings, one neighbour, so not independent.
